# mailchannels_sub_account (Resource)

A sub-account of the parent account whose API key configures the provider. Use sub-accounts to separate environments or customers. Set its monthly send limit with `mailchannels_sub_account_limit`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mailchannels_sub_account" "staging" {
  handle       = "examplestaging"
  company_name = "Example Inc. (staging)"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `company_name` (String) Display name, 3 to 128 characters. The Email API cannot rename a sub-account, so changing it replaces the sub-account.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the sub-account can send. `false` suspends it. Defaults to `true`.
- `handle` (String) Unique handle, 3 to 128 lower-case letters and digits. Generated by MailChannels when omitted. Changing it replaces the sub-account.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The handle.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Sub-accounts are imported by handle.
terraform import mailchannels_sub_account.staging examplestaging
```
